policy.text: UTF-8; surrounding spaces removed; no control, line-separator, replacement or subtitle markup, bidirectional overrides/isolates or caption-marker characters
policy.timing: integral milliseconds; 0 <= start < end; start >= previous end; end <= ceil(audio ms)

review.statement: Automatic speech recognition output is not certified. Hashes, strict structure, timing bounds and exact file agreement prove only that these files were derived consistently from the recorded native run; a person must review the transcript and captions against the audio before relying on them.
